title: [Feature][Training] Collect versioned target features for external draft
body:
Collect owned LM-head inputs during the existing target forward, with immutable head snapshots and atomic versioned manifests. Original sample/group/rollout identities and causal token/mask positions survive packing; missing rollout provenance stays unknown. Collection is disabled by default.

**Review this feature:** [incremental diff](https://github.com/0z5a/vime/compare/a5b3e0b17f0f406fb9912f1953fb5b9f8447bb64...76ad2be4a1fa2a90fbe3ff4a8ce08f64f1ec4020) (**18 files, +1,157/-13**). Prerequisite: maintenance #460 at `a5b3e0b1`. Target: `0z5a-branch` at `3e569314` (merged #459); head `76ad2be4`. The Files changed tab includes maintenance. #452 is absorbed; old fork review #6 is superseded. Original history is preserved without force-push.

Supported: micro-batch 1, TP=PP=CP=DP=1, no VPP/MTP/MoE, bias-free head, one actor update per publication. Unsupported/skipped target forwards fail before collection. Selected tensors own their storage; a round owns one immutable head. Token/batch/tensor-byte budgets are checked before copying. Empty rounds publish no batch; failure removes only newly owned files. The per-round budget is not an RSS or retention cap.

| Actual validation on the current production tree | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Contract/collector/metadata/arguments/shared CPU regressions | **217 passed, 0 skipped** |
| A100 full-parameter BF16 Ouro: real generation → target forward → optimizer → full publication | **6 rounds passed**; 1,434,650,624 trainable parameters; nonzero gradients each round |
| Physical serving/target equality | **PASS**: all 269 tensors after every publication and before every generation |
| Reloaded selected-token logits from features + same-version head | **PASS**: max/mean error **0.0/0.0**, repeat noise 0; 16 selected tokens in each of 7 rounds |
| Separate-process restore + seventh real update | **PASS**: model/Adam steps/RNG/cursor restored; generation version 7; fresh artifact namespace |
| Underlying native 3 vs 2 + fresh-process 1 | **PASS**: all 1,074 model/Adam/RNG checkpoint chunks and scheduler exactly equal |
| Maintenance prerequisite vs feature-off; feature-off vs on | **PASS for all 3 pairs**: six complete 1,074-chunk state comparisons, identical real-rollout replay, loss and gradient results |
| Ordinary Qwen actor path | **PENDING**: zero native optimizer updates. Aligned NCCL short check passed; six-round native collector and fresh restore remain queued |
| Maintenance CPU CI follow-up | **PASS locally**: Python 3.11 plugin/agent/utils stages, all 33 upstream-sync CPU files; stale Ouro loader list fixed |
| Formatting / diff checks | **PASS** |
| [CI #1405](https://buildkite.com/vllm/vime-ci/builds/1405) | **PASS automated checks**; GitHub success; Buildkite reports passed and blocked, so manual stages remain unexecuted; no manual rerun |

Ouro: pinned `ByteDance/Ouro-1.4B@574fa66c`, one A100-SXM4-40GB, TP=PP=CP=DP=1, existing Python 3.12.3 / Torch 2.13.0+cu130 / Ray 2.58.0. No dependency or driver updates. Private checks compare actual serving tensors and reload exported files; extra audit work is excluded from speed runs. The first extended-horizon resume failed; the standard `--use-checkpoint-opt-param-scheduler` option preserved saved scheduler state and the next run passed. Original failed evidence is retained outside Git.

Each row measures one full fixed-replay training/publication step from the same pinned checkpoint. Model initialization and the final checkpoint write are excluded. Collector export is included; extra logit-reconstruction matmuls are excluded. These are collector costs, not online generation throughput. Torch allocated-memory peaks are captured at optimizer completion.

| Pair | Order | Off step (s) | On step (s) | Off/on ratio | On overhead | Response tokens | Export MiB | On train GPU peak GiB |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | off → on | 26.074 | 27.634 | 0.944× | +5.98% | 256 | 192.06 | 32.83 |
| 2 | on → off | 26.519 | 26.734 | 0.992× | +0.81% | 256 | 192.06 | 32.83 |
| 3 | off → on | 24.429 | 27.122 | 0.901× | +11.02% | 256 | 192.06 | 32.83 |

Three-run median: off **26.074 s** (range 24.429–26.519), on **27.122 s** (range 26.734–27.634); median off/on ratio **0.961×**.

Each run replays the same saved real rollout and performs a real target forward, optimizer update and engine publication. All six native-state comparisons passed. No draft optimizer or speculative acceleration is included.

CPU reproduction:
```bash
python -m pytest -q tests/test_draft_feature_contract.py tests/test_draft_feature_collector.py \
  tests/test_draft_feature_metadata.py tests/test_megatron_argument_validation.py \
  tests/test_vllm_rollout.py tests/test_mem_agent_nvlink_detect.py \
  tests/test_server_idle_contract.py tests/test_docs_consistency.py
```
`tests/integration/run_draft_feature_ouro.py` wraps the real Ouro recipe. Head/feature ownership, JSON round-trip, reordered/masked token positions, budgets and failure cleanup have focused regressions. The existing [version](https://github.com/vllm-project/vime/pull/454#discussion_r4114684847), [micro-batch](https://github.com/vllm-project/vime/pull/454#discussion_r4114684852), [head](https://github.com/vllm-project/vime/pull/454#discussion_r4114684853) and [empty-round](https://github.com/vllm-project/vime/pull/454#discussion_r4114684857) review cases are covered.
